text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond and I go watch the Kikuka Sho, where Kitasan Black has an incredible race and secures first place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inspired, Satono Diamond requests additional training the next day. However, excessive training can lead to injuries.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To help vent some of that excess excitement, we opt to break jinxes at the academy as a form of less physically demanding training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With some help from some friends, including Mejiro Palmer, we successfully break ten jinxes! Satono Diamond seems quite satisfied!
